result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer stops the export. I haven't run a renamed-aspect case. The `reports` tests matching `DataExport*` ran clean, but I didn't check whether any of them cover this path.

The change is in `aspectFileLists` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It used to look for five fixed file names (`aspect_main.txt` … `aspect_other.txt`). It now builds each name from the configured main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, using `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same method that names the loose text files.

With the default config the names and order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written too, because the failed zip step no longer aborts it. I also updated the method's javadoc to match.
